tagline.en: AgiBot's GO-1 — a vision-language-action foundation policy with a latent planner and diffusion action expert, built for fine-tuning.
tagline.zh: AgiBot 的 GO-1——带隐式规划器与扩散 action expert 的视觉-语言-动作基座策略,面向微调。

en: GO-1 is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from AgiBot (AgiBot-World). It reads visual observations and instructions and predicts robot actions, and is released as a pretrained foundation checkpoint meant to be fine-tuned for specific tasks.

Its architecture combines an InternVision encoder and an InternLM2 language model with a latent planner, an action expert, and a diffusion sampler, together with the tokenizer and preprocessing — all implemented in WorldFoundry. The runtime executes only staged safetensors and never imports checkpoint-provided Python. Because normalization is tied to the training statistics, any fine-tune must stay paired with the exact dataset statistics emitted during its own training.
In WorldFoundry, GO-1 runs from local weights for policy rollout and embodied-benchmark tasks; the upstream recommendation is to full-fine-tune it on your downstream data.
zh: GO-1 是 AgiBot(AgiBot-World)推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型。它读取视觉观测与指令并预测机器人动作,以预训练基座 checkpoint 形式发布,面向针对具体任务的微调。

其架构把 InternVision 编码器与 InternLM2 语言模型,同隐式规划器、action expert 和扩散采样器结合起来,再加上 tokenizer 与预处理——全部在 WorldFoundry 中实现。运行时只执行准备好的 safetensors,绝不导入 checkpoint 自带的 Python。由于归一化与训练统计量绑定,任何微调都必须与其自身训练时产出的精确数据集统计量配套使用。
在 WorldFoundry 中,GO-1 从本地权重运行,用于策略 rollout 与具身 benchmark 任务;上游推荐在你的下游数据上做全参数微调。

whenToUse.en: A strong foundation when you want to fine-tune a capable VLA policy on your own robot data, with an InternVision + InternLM2 backbone and a diffusion action head.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想在自己的机器人数据上微调一个能力较强的 VLA 策略时,它是很好的基座——采用 InternVision + InternLM2 主干与扩散动作头。

notFor.en: The base checkpoint isn't a finished task policy; upstream expects downstream fine-tuning. A normalized fine-tune must carry its exact matching dataset statistics, and the checkpoint is downloaded separately.
notFor.zh: 基座 checkpoint 并非成品任务策略,上游期望做下游微调。归一化后的微调必须携带其精确匹配的数据集统计量,且 checkpoint 需单独下载。
